names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 14 noiembrie, «Sfântul Ierarh Grigorie Palama, Arhiepiscopul Tesalonicului».

birth.note: The year the Orthodox Church in America’s life gives.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru prints «ок. 1360» — about 1360 — beside his name for 14 November (old style).

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 14 ноября ст. ст. — «Свт. Григория Паламы, архиеп. Фессалонитского (ок. 1360)»

feast.note: doxologia.ro keeps him on 14 noiembrie. Its life of him adds, in a footnote, that he is also celebrated on the second Sunday of the Great Fast, that at the monastery of the Great Lavra his memory was moved to 5 noiembrie because it fell together with the Apostle Philip's, and that at Thessalonica, on the testimony of Symeon of Thessalonica, he was kept on 13 noiembrie with John Chrysostom; none of those is held here, the moveable one because it is not a fixed day.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 14 noiembrie — «Sfântul Ierarh Grigorie Palama, Arhiepiscopul Tesalonicului»
